# SCI-FRUIT Stage A instruction review

Date: 2026-09-06. Manager review of packet r0.1 at
`c06bc16f875f7e48628cc7921db705e775a41241`.

## Finding

The r0.1 packet did not warrant the manager's readiness claim. Its hash and
link checks established file identity, not compliance with the Stage A
instructions. The request to approve and launch that packet is withdrawn.
Its exact files remain unchanged. The approved scientific-core scope and
sequence exception remain in force.

This review follows the [program charter](../../../../../README.md),
[Scope Brief template](../../../../../templates/SCOPE_BRIEF.md),
[recovery template](../../../../../templates/PRIOR_WORK.md),
[package template](../../../../../templates/PACKAGE_README.md),
[pilot workflow](../../../../../PILOT_PROCESS_REVIEW_2026-08-16.md) and
[approved core scope](../../empirical_lane/SCIENTIFIC_CORE_CONTRACT_SCOPE_OWNER_REVIEW_R0.1.md).
The shortcomings are substantive, not a requirement to copy heading style.

## Requirements, deficiencies and repairs

| Governing instruction | r0.1 finding | r0.2 repair |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scope template 2: define where the operation begins and ends | The brief described conceptual roles but left the actual input/output boundary to later authorship | Scope section 2 names the start, end and adjacent operations; it separates role definition from numerical selection |
| Scope template 3 and 6: legitimate inputs, known units/identity/shape/frame/timing/validity and external conventions | Broad statements that a future method must declare everything did not identify the scientific input classes or known inherited quantity conventions | Scope sections 3 and 6 distinguish measured signal, target/model, operators, initialization/continuation, learning/termination and optional response/uncertainty; include the known PTC-to-MAP quantity convention |
| Scope template 4: scientifically meaningful required outputs | The brief named topics and later author documents without a clear output-role inventory or required/conditional distinction | Scope section 4 identifies iteration result, successor state, continuation information, termination/terminal identity and claim disclosures; actual numerical bundles and persistence remain unselected |
| Scope template 10; approved core scope requires precise remaining core choices | The decision map restated approved topics, grouped numerical deferrals and asserted readiness without mapping the existing ordered questions | The successor ledger maps ODQ-001, 001A–F and 002–012 individually to current authority, bounded derivation, remaining owner decision and blocked claim; no numerical question is silently closed |
| Charter Stage A output 1: internal dossier, separate from sanitized brief | The packet did not identify a current successor dossier; the existing dossier described the earlier implementation revision | The new internal dossier explicitly reuses that dated inventory, adds the bounded-review disposition and records exactly which questions can cross the firewall |
| Charter required opening and package template: current, consistent package links | Package README and program index still directed Gate 0 work and linked the older scope as the candidate; they did not identify the new review set | Current navigation points to this successor and identifies historical records; recovery and opening also explicitly identify the investigator review and pending owner review |
| Charter scientific meaning and proportional documentation; pilot reuse requirement | Integrity bookkeeping was treated as a sufficient completion check; program and topic restatements obscured the scientific task | The brief follows the full scientific template, reuses boundary mathematics and separates document checks from substantive manager review |
| Explicit recorded owner dispatch direction | The r0.1 manager README mandated Ultra without carrying the recorded xhigh effort instruction | Successor manager guidance preserves the explicit xhigh effort; no launch or silent settings change occurs |

The last row follows the
[September 1 owner record](../../SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_STAGE_A_R0.8_ACCEPTANCE_AND_STAGE_B_REQUEST_2026-09-01.md).
It is a dispatch-instruction repair, not a new scientific owner question.

## What passed and remains preserved

The exact reference hashes, PTC excerpt byte identity, restricted author links
and exclusion of code/experimental outcomes passed. Adjacent ownership and
the absence of an admitted numerical profile were correctly preserved. These
parts are reused. Neither missing numerical qualification nor absence of
Stage B LaTeX/PDF deliverables is a Stage A defect under the approved core
exception; producing the scientific derivation here would cross stages.

## Successor review

The successor has both required Stage A outputs: the
[internal dossier](INTERNAL_DOSSIER.md) and the separate
[sanitized Scope Brief](author/SCOPE_BRIEF.md), backed by
[prior-work recovery](PRIOR_WORK.md) and an explicit
[decision ledger](author/SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md).

Manager review checked all eleven Scope Brief sections, the distinction
between scientific outputs and author deliverables, all eighteen existing
decision rows, source roles and firewall separation. This is a completed
preparation repair, not owner approval of its scientific boundary or exact
references. The successor is returned for Stage A review; the manager does
not repeat a launch request as the conclusion of this instruction review.
